page_title: VER 3-1 ATA | Verona v Atalanta 06/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) is penalised for holding. Maurizio Mariani signals a set piece.
90+6' Verona players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.

90+4' Great solo effort by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) as he tricks his way through two defenders before firing a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper is ready and produces a stunning save.
90+2' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Martin Frese will be replaced by Nicolas Valentini (Verona).
90+2' The game has come to an end for Rafik Belghali. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Grigoris Kastanos (Verona).
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' A pass by Rafik Belghali (Verona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
89' Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Carnesecchi, who smothers the ball.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) will replace Giovane.
88' Paolo Zanetti has decided to make a change. Abdou Harroui (Verona) replaces Cheikh Niasse.
87' Amin Sarr (Verona) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
86' Verona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
84' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
81' 3 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Lorenzo Montipo no chance!
81' The substitution is prepared. Amin Sarr (Verona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Daniel Mosquera.
81' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Atalanta!
80' Referee Maurizio Mariani makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Atalanta. Let’s see what happens!
76' Maurizio Mariani sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
73' Maybe there was an infringement in the build up to the Verona goal as the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
71' 3 - 0 Antoine Bernede (Verona) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
71' The ball is cleared after Rafik Belghali (Verona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
70' Here comes a substitution. Charles De Ketelaere is given a rest as he is replaced by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).
69' Giovane (Verona) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Maurizio Mariani who sees an offensive foul.
66' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
65' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is booked by the referee.
64' A player from Verona commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
64' Giovane (Verona) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
61' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) replacing Davide Zappacosta.
61' We are about to witness a substitution. Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) is replacing Ederson.
61' Giovane (Verona) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
60' The linesman points to the corner flag, Verona are going to take it.
59' One of the Atalanta players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Verona.
58' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
56' A player from Verona commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
55' Martin Frese (Verona) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
53' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
53' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
50' Martin Frese (Verona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Maurizio Mariani had an easy-decision to make.

50' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the bottom left corner. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save.
49' Verona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
48' Rafik Belghali (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to Verona.
48' The corner is swung in but Verona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

47' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Verona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
46' Raffaele Palladino has decided to substitute Nikola Krstovic and he is replaced by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta).
46' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) comes on the pitch for Odilon Kossounou.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' The ball is cleared after Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Victor Nelsson (Verona) is shown a yellow card by the referee.

45' Victor Nelsson (Verona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Atalanta are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
45' One of the players from Verona times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
44' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
42' Atalanta are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.

41' Lorenzo Montipo makes a brilliant save! Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper!
40' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
39' Rafik Belghali (Verona) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
39' Verona are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
36' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Giovane (Verona) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Marco Carnesecchi. He makes it 2:0.
35' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Atalanta.
34' Atalanta show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
31' A crossfield pass from Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) fails to find any of his teammates. The linesman signals a throw-in for Verona.

28' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Daniel Mosquera, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Rafik Belghali (Verona), who beats Marco Carnesecchi with a brilliant shot into the top of the net. 1:0.
27' Atalanta take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

24' Giovane (Verona) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Marco Carnesecchi has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save.
21' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Daniel Mosquera (Verona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
18' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

17' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Lorenzo Montipo pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom right corner. The ball is out of play and Atalanta manage to earn a corner.
17' The free kick into the box finds Isak Hien (Atalanta), who heads the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the keeper pulls off a fantastic reflex save. Great goalkeeping skills.
14' Giovane (Verona) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. It's a throw-in for Atalanta.
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
11' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Good work from Atalanta as they win a corner.
11' The referee blows his whistle, Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
11' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Atalanta have a corner.
9' A goal, which was scored by Giovane (Verona), was disallowed due to offside.
7' Verona are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear. The ball is out of play. Atalanta will have a throw-in.
4' Atalanta couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
2' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani is introduced as the referee for today's match.
